summary: @dan_blick of course now I have to jam on Bootzilla me and Bootsy run deep in the rhinestone flow of my arteries "Oh yeah I am programmable, one hit of the dial"
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@dan_blick
of course now I have to
jam on Bootzilla
me and Bootsy run deep
in the rhinestone flow
of my arteries
"Oh yeah I am programmable,
one hit of the dial"
